editorial:
Flash Gordon Conquers the Universe is a Universal Pictures sound serial directed by Ford Beebe and Ray Taylor. The Internet Archive holds its chapters. Part 1 runs 19 minutes, and its description has Flash, Dale and Zarkov returning to Planet Mongo to find an antidote for the Purple Death. A creator would want the footage as ready-made period adventure material.

The rights question is unresolved. The film is from the 1940s, so it is free only if its copyright was not renewed in the 28th-year window. I could not confirm a renewal or its absence. The Archive's own metadata gives no license for the item and has no copyright finding. Check the renewal records before reusing the footage. Also check separately for any character or source-material rights, which a film's expiry would not end.
faq: Is Flash Gordon Conquers the Universe public domain?
Not established. It is a 1940s Universal serial, so it is free only if its copyright was never renewed. I could not confirm that either way. The Internet Archive item metadata specifies no license.
Can I use the Flash Gordon characters in a new work?
Not safely. The film's copyright status does not settle any separate rights in the characters or source material. I did not confirm those rights, so clear them independently.
